newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil surges at close on technicals.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil surges at close on technicals.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Strong buying and technical support helped to push up prices sharply at the close. Talk of Indonesia's buying in the local market aided the market which saw technical buying when Dec futures breached 1,150. Next resistance will be at 1,180. Trading volume was huge.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL -Firmer and followed the futures. Saw interest among nearby CPOs. Selected products were traded.
The contract rose to a high of 1,170 ringgit today and traders said the next resistance will be 1,180 ringgit level.
"We feel that the market is gaining its strength and people are more positive that prices are turning upwards," a dealer said. "The market will resume the long uptrend."
Gains in most futures contracts were sharp.
Continuing talk that Indonesia was present in the market looking to buy December oil from Malaysia also propped up prices, dealers said.
But dealers were unable to disclose any further details on the Indonesian buying talk.
Some traders said the market looked oversold in recent days and it was only healthy for the market to correct itself.
The market expects India or Pakistan to come into the market to issue fresh tenders, they said.
Physical trading saw selective dealing among selected products.

Sept (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,185 ringgit a tonne after trading from 1,162.50 to 1,180. Sept (south) saw bids at 1,180. Sept (central) was offered at 1,170 with bids at 1,160, with early transactions at 1,150 and 1,155.
Oct/Nov/Dec (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,195 ringgit with bids at 1,187.50. Oct (central) saw offers at 1,180 and bids at 1,167.50 and Nov (central) at 1,187.50 with bids at 1,180.
In refined products, Oct RBD palmoil was offered at $510 a tonne FOB Malaysia and Nov/Dec at $507.50.
Oct palm olein saw offers at $547.50, Nov/Dec at $537.50 and Jan/Feb/Mch at $542.50. Oct was traded at $540 and Nov at $532
Oct RBD palm stearin was offered at $405, Nov at $410 and Sept/Oct/Nov palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $340. - Tan Lee Lee (603-2308911) ($1=2.5020 ringgit).
